title: Validate successful LTE Attach and Detach procedure for single UE in excellent radio conditions
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions, with 100% success rate and expected attach latency.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE placed in cell center with LTE RSRP meeting excellent radio condition criteria
All other cells powered off except serving cell
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration
Activate and unload the serving LTE cell; power off other cells
Place UE under excellent LTE radio conditions (verified via RSRP)
Start logging to capture call flows and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach
Wait for successful attach (attach request and attach complete messages validated)
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach
Wait for successful detach (detach request and detach accept messages validated, including UE context release and RRC connection release messages)
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, average, max) in test report
expectedResults: All 10 attach attempts succeed with 100% attach success rate
All 10 detach attempts succeed with 100% detach success rate
Attach latency values are within expected target KPIs
Logs confirm UE attached to correct cell (PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
No connectivity issues throughout test
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs and signalling messages for attach and detach success
Check KPI tables (5-2 and 5-3) for success rates and latency
Validate radio parameters (RSRP, RSRQ) during tests

title: Validate successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach procedure with Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Verify a single UE can successfully perform 5G NSA attach with EN-DC secondary node addition and detach with secondary node release 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE placed in cell center with 5G SS-RSRP meeting excellent radio condition criteria
All other cells powered off except serving cell
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup according to test configuration
Activate and unload the serving LTE/5G NSA cell; power off other cells
Place UE under excellent 5G NSA radio conditions (verified via 5G SS-RSRP)
Start logging to capture call flows and signalling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach (including EN-DC secondary node addition)
Wait for successful attach and secondary node addition (validate attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, SgNB reconfiguration complete messages)
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach and secondary node release
Wait for successful detach (validate detach request, detach accept, UE context release, RRC connection release, and secondary node release messages)
Stop and save logs
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations
Measure and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate in test report
expectedResults: All 10 attach attempts succeed with 100% attach and secondary node addition success rates
All 10 detach attempts succeed with 100% detach success rate
Logs confirm UE attached to correct LTE and 5G cells (PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)
No connectivity issues throughout test
verificationMethods: Analyze UE logs and signalling messages for attach, secondary node addition, and detach success
Check KPI tables (5-2) for success rates
Validate radio parameters (5G SS-RSRP) during tests

title: Negative test: Attach failure due to poor radio conditions below excellent threshold
description: Verify the system behavior when the UE attempts to attach under poor radio conditions that do not meet the excellent radio conditions criteria.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with no inter-cell interference
Stationary UE placed with LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP below the excellent radio condition threshold
All other cells powered off except serving cell
testSteps: Configure test setup with test configuration
Activate and unload serving cell
Place UE under poor radio conditions (below Clause 4.6 thresholds)
Start logging
Power ON the UE to initiate attach (LTE or 5G NSA as applicable)
Wait for attach attempt and observe results
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Stop and save logs
Repeat attach and detach attempts for multiple iterations
expectedResults: Attach attempts fail or have reduced success rate
Attach latency may increase or attach procedure may timeout
Detach procedure may not be initiated successfully if attach fails
Logs show attach request without corresponding attach complete
System handles attach failure gracefully without crashes or hangs
verificationMethods: Analyze attach failure messages in UE and network logs
Confirm absence of attach complete messages
Check error counters and failure reasons
Validate system stability during failures

title: Negative test: Detach failure due to signalling message loss
description: Verify system behavior when detach request or detach accept messages are lost or corrupted during the UE-initiated detach procedure.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with no inter-cell interference
UE successfully attached to LTE or 5G NSA cell under excellent radio conditions
testSteps: Start logging
Simulate loss or corruption of detach request message sent by UE
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Observe network response and UE behavior
Alternatively, simulate loss or corruption of detach accept message from network
Observe UE handling of missing messages
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: System detects missing messages and retries or recovers gracefully
UE remains connected or transitions to proper state after timeout
No resource leaks or hanging connections
Logs capture retransmissions or error handling
postconditions: System recovers to stable state after failure scenario
verificationMethods: Analyze signalling message flows for missing or retransmitted messages
Check UE and network state consistency
Verify absence of resource leaks or crashes

title: Edge test: Attach and detach with UE at minimum coupling loss boundary
description: Verify attach and detach procedures when the UE is placed at the minimum coupling loss boundary defined in Clause 4.6 to test edge radio conditions.
preconditions: Single cell scenario
UE positioned such that LTE RSRP or 5G SS-RSRP is exactly at minimum coupling loss threshold
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup with UE at minimum coupling loss boundary
Activate serving cell and power off others
Start logging
Power ON the UE to initiate attach
Wait for attach success or failure
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach
Wait for detach success
Repeat for 10 iterations
Record KPIs and latency
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully or fail consistently at boundary
Attach success rate and latency reported
System stable and consistent behavior observed at boundary
verificationMethods: Check attach/detach success rates and latency at boundary conditions
Analyze logs for any anomalies

title: Performance test: Attach and detach procedure latency measurement over 10 iterations
description: Measure attach latency and success rates for 10 consecutive attach and detach iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single UE in single cell with excellent radio conditions
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Set up test environment as per configuration
Start logging
For 10 iterations:
- Power ON UE to attach
- Record attach latency (time between attach request and attach complete)
- Power OFF UE to detach
Stop logging
Sort attach latency values and record min, average, max
expectedResults: Attach success rate 100%
Detach success rate 100%
Attach latency within expected KPI targets
Stable system performance without resource exhaustion
verificationMethods: Analyze timing in signalling logs
Validate KPI measurements against targets

title: Security test: Verify authentication and authorization during attach procedure
description: Verify that UE authentication and authorization are properly performed during LTE and 5G NSA attach procedures.
preconditions: Single UE with valid credentials
Serving cell active
Authentication server reachable
testSteps: Start logging
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Observe authentication messages and mechanisms (e.g., AKA procedure)
Verify successful authentication and authorization
Power OFF UE to detach
Stop logging
expectedResults: Authentication succeeds only for authorized UE
Unauthorized UE attach attempts rejected
No security breaches or bypasses observed
Logs confirm successful authentication steps
verificationMethods: Analyze authentication message flows
Validate rejection of unauthorized attach attempts
Check logs for security events

title: Integration test: Verify coordination between MN and SN during 5G NSA Secondary Node Release
description: Test the correct signaling flow and coordination between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during the SN Release procedure, both when MN initiated and SN initiated.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with EN-DC enabled
UE attached with active secondary node
MN and SN operational
testSteps: Start logging
Trigger MN initiated SN Release procedure
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Request
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Request Acknowledge
Check RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicating SCG release to UE
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify UE Context Release message reception by SN and resource release
Trigger SN initiated SN Release procedure
Verify SN sends SgNB Release Required message
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Confirm
Check RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicating SCG release to UE
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Verify UE Context Release message reception by SN and resource release
Stop logging
expectedResults: All signaling messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
MN and SN correctly coordinate data forwarding and release procedures
UE receives RRC reconfiguration message to release SCG
Radio and control plane resources released properly
No signaling errors or message loss
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling flows between MN and SN
Check logs for message correctness and timing
Validate UE reconfiguration and resource release

title: Usability test: Verify clarity and completeness of test logs and KPIs reporting
description: Ensure that test logs and KPI reporting are clear, complete, and easily interpretable for test engineers reviewing LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach tests.
preconditions: Test logs and KPI data from attach-detach test executions available
testSteps: Review test logs for completeness of call flows and signaling messages
Check KPI tables for attach success rate, detach success rate, secondary node addition/release success rate, and latency values
Verify all configuration parameters used are recorded in the test report
Assess clarity of documentation and ease of extracting test results
Gather feedback from test engineers on usability
expectedResults: Logs contain all necessary messages and timestamps
KPI tables are complete and correctly formatted
Configuration details are clearly documented
Test engineers find the reports easy to understand and use
verificationMethods: Manual review of logs and reports
User feedback collection

title: Compatibility test: Verify attach-detach procedures across different UE emulator versions
description: Test LTE and 5G NSA attach-detach procedures using different versions of UE emulators to verify compatibility and consistent behavior.
preconditions: Single cell test environment
Multiple UE emulator versions available
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: For each UE emulator version:
- Configure test setup accordingly
- Place UE emulator under excellent radio conditions
- Start logging
- Perform 10 iterations of attach and detach procedures
- Stop logging
- Record KPIs and compare results
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates meet 100% for all emulator versions
Attach latency within acceptable range with no significant variation
No compatibility issues or errors observed
Logs and KPIs consistent across versions
verificationMethods: Compare KPI results across emulator versions
Analyze logs for errors or anomalies
Confirm consistent attach/detach behavior
